title: Claim crates.io names for this session's new crates
description: Free on crates.io as of 2026-11-20 (checked via the crates.io API): jmap-vtc-aws, jmap-vtc-livekit, jmap-vtc-ffmpeg, jmap-vtc-gstreamer (alias for the ffmpeg/GStreamer backend, claim defensively), jmap-vtc-cloudflare, jmap-vtc-sip, jmap-chat-slack, jmap-platform-push. jmap-search is already ours (0.0.1). Claim each with a 0.0.1 placeholder from ~/PROJECT/jmap-name-claims/ as gs76 did (docs point at the real crate or bead), or publish the real crate for those already built (jmap-chat-slack, jmap-platform-push, jmap-vtc-aws) with 0.6.0. Publishing needs Mark's go; mind the crates.io new-crate rate limit (RELEASING.md blocker notes).
